name: Fibery
description:
Once Fibery MCP is connected to your workspace, Claude can do almost anything you can do in Fibery yourself — read and write data, or reshape your workspace structure.

1. Read & query
Explore your workspace structure (spaces, databases, fields), query any database with filtering, sorting, and sub-queries, run full-text search across entities, documents, and comments, inspect activity history (who changed what, and when), and pull data from saved views with their filters applied.

2. Create & update
Create, update, and delete entities, move them through workflow states, assign people and link related records, write documents, add comments, and attach files.

3. Modify structure
Create spaces and databases, add fields of any type available in Fibery (including formulas), and build views — boards, timelines, calendars, gantt charts, forms, and more.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Fibery to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fibery to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.fibery.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fibery MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fibery lists 55 MCP tools, including add_collection_items, add_comment, add_file_from_url, append_document_content, create_avatars_fields, create_comments_fields, create_databases, create_entities, create_files_fields, create_formula_field, create_icon_fields, and create_multi_select_fields.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fibery?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fibery in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Fibery requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Fibery is developed by Fibery. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
